parameters.ell: median positive adjacent Topomap node XY spacing (Phase42-L)
parameters.entry_anchor: reset after each MAP change,including revisits/window resets
parameters.visited_memory: record first MAP visit position once;never overwrite
parameters.initial: Phase42-L uniform prior in recorded window
parameters.window_reset: Phase42-L uniform reset if logged window has zero reachable mass;explicitly counted

input.run_selection: Final run metrics selected attempt;never open an unfinished attempt. Dynamic discovery at script start/resume,missing inputs reported.
input.odometry: saved observation XY at hmm_odometry_tick;current exact simulator odometry assumption
input.truth: saved node_errors,validated with Phase42-L nearest;fallback nearest only if absent

reports.primary_error: observation-time MAP-true_node,all logged measurements;delivered/declaration subset separate
reports.declarations: exact saved declaration inference ID;report would/would-not declare on old wrong and success cases,not new driving outcomes
reports.outside_window: previous MAP outside,prediction MAP outside,zero-reachable forced reset,posterior outside(0 by construction)
reports.replay_limit: logged candidate windows fixed,none synthesized,not an online counterfactual
